title: Deep-Cleaning Look-Back by Guest Record — Roamhaven Listings Decision Card
content:
# Deep-Cleaning Look-Back by Guest Record

*Decision card for Roamhaven Listings. It fixes the period over which a listing's deep-cleaning claims, and their verified losses, are read when its cleaning-fee ceiling is worked out on the day of a cleaning-fee reset.*

## Rule

The standard deep-cleaning look-back is the last **12** whole months before the day of the reset, a claim falling within it according to the date part of its filing moment. The look-back moves with the listing's guest record, read from the quality assessments recorded on the listing:

1. When any quality assessment recorded on the listing within the last twelve months (fewer than twelve whole months before the day of the reset) has outcome **warning** or **suspension**, the look-back is shortened to the last **6** whole months, so that only the deep-cleaning costs of the period the guests' complaints describe are credited.
2. When at least **6** quality assessments were recorded on the listing within the last twenty-four months and every one of them has outcome **pass**, the look-back is lengthened to the last **24** whole months.
3. Otherwise the standard deep-cleaning look-back of the last 12 whole months applies.

The lines are read in that order, and the first that holds decides.

## Decision table

| Guest record on the listing | Deep-cleaning claims and their losses are read over |
|---|---|
| a warning or suspension outcome within the last twelve months | the last 6 whole months |
| no such outcome; 6 or more assessments in the last twenty-four months, all of them pass | the last 24 whole months |
| anything else | the last 12 whole months |

## Cases (hypothetical assessment histories)

| Assessments recorded on the listing | Look-back |
|---|---|
| 8 in the last twenty-four months, all pass | 24 whole months |
| 6 in the last twenty-four months, all pass | 24 whole months — 6 is "at least 6" |
| 5 in the last twenty-four months, all pass | 12 whole months — fewer than 6 |
| 7 in the last twenty-four months: 6 pass and 1 not assessed | 12 whole months — not every one is a pass |
| a warning recorded four months ago, every other assessment pass | 6 whole months |
| a suspension recorded fourteen months ago, nothing in the last twelve months but passes | 12 whole months — the suspension is outside the last twelve months, and not every assessment of the twenty-four months is a pass |
